sentiment.rationale: The document reports a 2.3% GAAP net revenue increase and 2.7% organic revenue growth, with core EPS up 7% on a constant currency basis. However, full-year 2024 guidance is reaffirmed unchanged: 'at least 4 percent increase in organic revenue' and 'at least 8 percent increase in core constant currency EPS' — the same as previously stated. Management's tone is confident but hedged, noting 'a difficult net revenue growth comparison from the prior year' and the impact of product recalls at Quaker Foods North America. Since guidance was neither raised nor lowered, and the quarter's results are backward-looking, the score is neutral.

summary.revenue: Reported net revenue of $18,250 million for the 12 weeks ended March 23, 2024, up 2.3% year-over-year. Organic revenue growth was 2.7%.
summary.eps: Reported diluted EPS of $1.48, up 6% year-over-year. Core diluted EPS was $1.61, up 7% on a constant currency basis.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2024 guidance reaffirmed: at least 4% organic revenue growth, at least 8% core constant currency EPS growth, core annual effective tax rate of 20%, total cash returns to shareholders of approximately $8.2 billion, and an approximate 1-percentage-point foreign exchange translation headwind. Implies 2024 core EPS of at least $8.15.
summary.margin: Reported gross margin decreased 43 bps; core gross margin increased 20 bps. Reported operating margin increased 5 bps; core operating margin increased 79 bps.
key_risks: Product recall at Quaker Foods North America (voluntary recall of certain bars and cereals) impacting net revenue and operating profit.
Foreign exchange translation headwind of approximately 1 percentage point on reported net revenue and core EPS growth.
Risks associated with the deadly conflict in Ukraine, water scarcity, climate change, cyber incidents, and other factors listed in the Cautionary Statement.
key_opportunities: Continued productivity initiatives to support investments in brands, capabilities, and pep+ initiatives.
52nd consecutive annual dividend increase (7% annualized increase) beginning June 2024.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Ramon Laguarta stated 'our businesses remained agile and performed well' and 'we continue to expect to deliver at least 4 percent organic revenue growth and at least 8 percent core constant currency EPS growth in 2024,' indicating confidence in the outlook despite acknowledged headwinds.
